source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Πέτρος ο ασκητής και Ακεψιμάς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names both its members, so it is one folder per named member and each relates the other. It names its witnesses plainly — the Synaxaristes of Delehaye and the Parisian Codex 1578 — and says only that they were martyred in Persia; that is sources cited, not the site's own mark of doubt, and there is no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. No year and no king, so no `dates` object. The same day's separate entry «Άγιοι Αειθαλάς και Ακεψεής» carries a different name, Ἀκεψεής, and is drafted apart. No hymn is printed. The by-name «ο ασκητής» is kept in the English form and not in the `types` list, because `lib/honorific.js` composes the rank itself and a stored `ascetic` type beside that name would reach the reader twice.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
